Chapter 636 - 636 Anger; Revenge!

Chapter 636 - 636 Anger; Revenge!

636 Anger; Revenge!

Even for some super internet celebrities, 2.2 million online users was a very impressive number.

What was more, Xia Xue was not a super internet celebrity.

In fact, she was not even a professional streamer. She only broadcasted in her free time after school and holidays.

Under such circumstances, getting 2.2 million viewers was even more impressive.

At this moment, countless comments filled the live broadcast room.

The Person in My Heart: [I’ve learned a lot today.]

I’m At Home: [Imperial Hotel is the greatest of all time.]

Yours is Mine: [So, has anyone found out who that young man is?]

Clenching Fist: [Ah, Xia Xue finally turned the camera over.]

Nothing Is Difficult in the World: [Xia Xue, you’re so beautiful.]]

…

Seeing this, Xia Xue smiled and said, “Thank you for your praise.”

After the audience heard Xia Xue’s voice, there were even more comments.

Low-Key Not Bro: [Xia Xue, you finally spoke. Why didn’t you stay at the Imperial Hotel just now?]

???: [I like Xiao Xue very much, but this time, I also think that Xiao Xue should’ve stayed.]

Zhao XX: [Xiao Xue, do you know how much that meal just cost? At least 100,000 World Coins!]

Guardian: [100,000 World Coins? That car just now cost 30 million World Coins!]

Long-Legged Beauty: [Xia Xue missed a chance to turn into a princess. Moreover, that guy is so handsome!]

Lang Lang: [What a pity, what a pity.]

Words From the Roadside: [Xia Xue, how do you know that young master? Please introduce me!]

Who Am I: [Yeah, who is that young master? Introduce him to me. I’ve never seen such a handsome person.]

…

Xia Xue looked at the comments and was slightly stunned.

Then, she coughed lightly and said, “Uhh… It’s getting late. Today’s live broadcast ends here. Thank you for your time. See you next time.”

Qing Tian: [Don’t go offline!]

Song: [Xia Xue, please continue the live broadcast.]

Lights of Ten Thousand Families: [Tell me who that young man is before you go offline.]

…

However, Xia Xue did not seem to see the comments and directly closed the live broadcast room.

She turned around and looked at the straight road. Lin Fan’s tall and handsome figure appeared in her mind.

Yes, he was very handsome.

After a while, Xia Xue shook her head hard. She finally withdrew her thoughts and walked toward Jiangbei University.

….

In Jiangbei, there was a European-style castle that occupied an area of about 80,000 square meters.

Ordinary people were not allowed to approach at all. They did not know who built this castle and thought it was an unopened scenic spot.

However, some of the upper echelons knew that this castle belonged to the Wang family.

It was said that the Wang family had a history of nearly a thousand years.

They had endless wealth and were one of the few families that controlled mines.

Everyone in this castle, be it servants or masters… Their lives were comfortable and leisurely.

This was the power that a powerful foundation and strength gave them.

However, today, the entire castle was filled with a different kind of urgency.

At this moment, the current head of the Wang family, Wang Hao, the previous heads, Wang Ziyun, Wang Yue, Wang Qi, and many other core members of the Wang family were gathered.

There were six generations of the family present!

A thousand years ago, it was very rare for four generations to live under the same roof.

However, after a thousand years, both the environment and medical technology had greatly improved, which greatly increased the lifespan of people.

Now, four generations living together had become a common phenomenon, and five generations living together was also considered normal.

As for the Wang family, which had endless wealth and power, they had reached the point where six generations were under the same roof.

Wang Qi said in a slightly hoarse voice, “Is everyone here?”

Wang Hao, who was at the side, hunched over and said, “Everyone is here.”

“Remember, when you see Mr. Lin tomorrow, we must be respectful!” Wang Qi glanced around and said.

“Yes, Sir!” everyone said in unison.

At this moment, Wang Hao’s phone rang.

“Grandpa, Mr. Lin seems to have appeared on a live broadcast,” Wang Hao said anxiously.

“Live broadcast?” Wang Qi was puzzled. “Let’s take a look.”

“Alright,” Wang Hao said.

Then, a high-definition 3D projection appeared in the spacious hall.

“I’ll take out twice the money to buy the Deep Sea Golden Gall and the Giant Scorpion you ordered. In addition, I’ll offer another 100,000 World Coins for your private room. How about it?”

…

“Brat, how dare you?!”

…

“General Manager Wang, how will your hotel handle this matter?!”

…

Seeing this…

Wang Qi, who had always been calm and collected, suddenly showed a cold gaze as he said sternly, “Impudent!”

His voice was not loud.

However, it made everyone present shiver in fear.

The temperature of the entire hall seemed to drop to freezing point in an instant.

“He insulted Mr. Lin and deserves to be exterminated!”

…

Almost at the same time, the direct descendants of the ancient Zhang family, the ancient Ran family, and the ancient Ma family were also gathered together. They watched the same live broadcast.

…

On the other hand, in the Fang family.

Fang Wenjie lay on lifelessly, unable to move at all.

Li Weiwen, who had heavy makeup on, looked at his pitiful appearance and shouted, “Who is it? Son, who beat you up like this?”

Fang Wenjie said with difficulty, “It’s the Wang family.”

At this moment, Patriarch Fang Lei walked in.

“Fang Lei, what are you still doing here?” Li Weiwen immediately cried. “Why aren’t you taking revenge for your son? Look at how badly he’s been beaten!”

At this moment, Fang Lei’s expression was extremely ugly.

Firstly, Fang Lei only had one son. He usually doted on Fang Wenjie very much and had never been willing to hit him.

But now, his legs had been broken!

Secondly, he knew what had happened. His son had already reported his name, but in the end, his legs were still broken.

This was twice the humiliation, and it even happened in public.

How hateful!

“Don’t worry, I’ll definitely make them pay the heaviest price!” Fang Lei said.

“The Imperial Hotel? Humph!”

As he spoke, he picked up his foldable phone and dialed a number.

However, no one picked up the phone after a long time.

Fang Lei could not help but frown.

At this moment, the call was returned.

Before Fang Lei could speak, an extremely urgent voice sounded from inside.

“President Fang, bad news. Dafang Group’s shares have suddenly been sold off in large quantities. The share price has already plunged by 20%!

“In addition, Shunli Express, Wanjia Group, Hengfeng Group… All of them have severed their cooperative relations with us.

“Just now… the World Bank informed us that they’ll stop lending us money.

“The Xia Alliance also wants to investigate our taxes. President Fang, think of a solution! I’ll hang up first.”
